description: Details pursuant to the partial discharge of Condition 89 (Details of Cranes) for the Town Centre West phase only of planning permission reference 585/APP/2015/848 dated 21-12-2015. Variation of condition 5 of planning permission ref: 585/APP/2009/2752 dated 18/01/2012 (redevelopment of former RAF Uxbridge site) to amend approved plans and drainage strategy regarding the Town Centre Extension phase of the development.
decision_conditions: The details are approved in part for the time period between 1st June 2022 and 31st October 2025 for the Town Centre West phase only. The applicant is advised that further details are required to discharge the condition prior to the commencement of any further work on site carried out above 8m AGL.
